name: Crimson Dusk
description: Warm charcoal, muted plum, rose accents and restrained crimson, extracted from the animated-character website CSS.

glow.name: Burgundy haze
glow.role: Center of a restrained decorative glow

text-on-action.name: Rose white
text-on-action.role: Labels on crimson actions and dark buttons

text-soft.name: Mauve blush
text-soft.role: Status labels and soft secondary emphasis

accent.name: Soft rose
accent.role: Small labels, links and accent text

indicator.name: Raspberry
indicator.role: Small status dots and decorative accents

ai_instructions: Use a dark theme with warm, slightly pink whites and muted plum surfaces.
Use background for the page; surface or surface-raised for cards and controls.
Use text for primary copy and text-muted for supporting copy. Use text-on-action over action.
Use action sparingly for primary calls to action and selected states; use accent for links and small highlights.
Keep large areas dark. Do not use crimson as a full-page background.
Use the glow gradient only as a subtle decorative effect behind focal content.
Keep keyboard focus visible using focus. Border is decorative and low contrast; do not rely on it alone to identify an essential control.
Do not invent light-mode, hover, success, warning or error colors from these values without marking them as extensions. These were not present in the original website.
Do not treat indicator as a semantic error color: it was a decorative status dot in the original design.
Preserve the supplied hex values when reproducing this palette.
